page_title: REN 3-1 PSG | Rennes v PSG 13/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' That didn't go as planned! Kang-In Lee (PSG) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Brice Samba, who easily kept it out.

90+3' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
90+3' PSG get a corner.

90+3' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Brice Samba guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
90+1' Mousa Tamari will be replaced by Elias Legendre (Rennes).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
86' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' 4:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
81' 3 - 1 Goal! Ludovic Blas passes the ball to the feet of Breel Embolo (Rennes), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:1.

79' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
78' A pass into the box finds Goncalo Ramos (PSG) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Brice Samba denies him.
77' Nuno Mendes (PSG) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
75' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Here is a change. Ousmane Dembele is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
74' Substitution. Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) in, Sebastian Szymanski out.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Breel Embolo (Rennes) will replace Esteban Lepaul.

72' 2 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Achraf Hakimi finds Ousmane Dembele (PSG), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Brice Samba had no chance of stopping that. 2:1.
71' Joao Neves goes off the pitch and Dro Fernandez (PSG) comes on.

69' 2 - 0 Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Sebastian Szymanski. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 2:0.
69' The referee points to the corner flag and Rennes will take a corner.

69' A pass lands at the feet of Ludovic Blas (Rennes) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.
68' 9:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' It is time for a substitution. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is on for Arnaud Nordin.
65' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

64' Willian Pacho (PSG) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
64' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.
63' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
60' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and he is replaced by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Desire Doue leaves the pitch and Bradley Barcola (PSG) comes on.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.

57' Desire Doue (PSG) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
55' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
50' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.

47' The opposition can't get near Arnaud Nordin (Rennes), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The PSG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
39' Close! Joao Neves (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.

38' Desire Doue (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. PSG will take a throw-in.

34' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Mousa Tamari (Rennes) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
32' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Brice Samba.
32' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Matvey Safonov thwarted him with a fabulous save.
30' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is caught offside!
29' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
28' Desire Doue (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to PSG.
27' A quickly taken corner by PSG.
26' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
25' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
24' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
24' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Desire Doue (PSG) inside the box.
23' Desire Doue (PSG) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
21' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Bastien had a clear view and blows his whistle.
16' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
12' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Desire Doue (PSG) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
12' Rennes take a short corner kick.

11' The ball is cleared after Mousa Tamari (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

6' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
3' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Rennes will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien was nominated as the referee for this game.
